applicabilityBasis.summary: BUSD is minted one to one through the HoneyFactory contract against a governance-set basket of whitelisted stablecoins and redeemed for those digital assets, subject to per-asset fees and Basket Mode proportional redemption when any collateral depegs. Official materials market it for payments and remittances, but they identify no legal issuer obligated to redeem for a fixed amount of national currency or bank-deposit monetary value, and documented redemption delivers other digital assets, so applicability remains unclear.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-28. Formerly HONEY; renamed Bera USD with symbol BUSD on 2026-08-19 at the same contract address, with no migration. The Coinbase MiCA restriction list names no BUSD or Bera USD entry; its BUST entry is a different asset. Official documentation credits minting and redemption to the HoneyFactory contract under governance-configured rates and names no issuing legal person, so no issuerEntity is recorded. reserveDisclosurePresent reflects the live redeemable-collateral display on the official BUSD application page; it is an on-chain collateral view, not an attested reserve report. Redemption delivers collateral stablecoins, not currency or bank-deposit monetary value.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-28, Federal Register searches, official issuer domains and token-specific searches found no GENIUS permitted payment stablecoin issuer approval, state qualification, official application or foreign-issuer registration for Berachain's Bera USD (BUSD, formerly HONEY). No legal issuer is identified to hold such a status. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no unpublished filing exists.
